## What SarconX does
SarconX is a digital consulting and growth studio based in Pavia with a strong presence in Milano. We help Italian SMEs and larger companies design strategy, build websites, e-commerce, apps and operational software, and run marketing and growth programs that produce measurable results.

Our approach is concrete, not hype-driven: we start from the business goal, choose the right tools (strategy, design, technology, automation), and deliver done-for-you services that free up the client's team.

## Services
- Consulenza strategica digitale — business model, positioning and channel strategy
- Marketing & Growth — funnel, content, campaigns and metrics to acquire the right clients
- Siti web e esperienza digitale — websites and digital experiences designed to convert
- E-commerce su misura — custom stores with optimized catalog and checkout
- Applicazioni, web app e software — apps, web apps and tailored operational software
- Servizi done-for-you — recurring operational services that give time back to the team

## Service area
Primary: Pavia, Milano and Lombardia.
Secondary: all of Italy, with remote consulting, design and delivery plus on-site meetings when required.
